description: Find and remove personal data (PII: names, emails, phone numbers, NHS/SSN numbers, etc.) from text. Use this BEFORE sharing, storing or sending text that may contain personal data. Returns the anonymized text.

allowList.description: Values that must never be anonymized

country.description: Country and regulation as "regulation|country|sub-region|language", e.g. "UK GDPR|United Kingdom||en". Use list_countries to see valid values. Defaults to the first country in the account plan.

denyList.description: Values that must always be anonymized

method.description: redact -> [REDACTED]; replace -> <PERSON>; mask -> ****; hash -> short SHA-256; pseudonymization -> realistic fake value; tokenization -> ENTITY_001; encryption -> reversible with the key in NEXIS_ENCRYPTION_KEY (decrypt_text is only available when the server sets NEXIS_ALLOW_DECRYPT=true)

selectedEntities.description: Only process these entity types (e.g. EMAIL_ADDRESS)

name: anonymize_text
title: Anonymize text
